Name: (Buff) Maplestory Buff Package
Author: To2morrow
Description:
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Add Maplestory Skill Buffs (KMS ver)[/b][/color][/*]
[*][b]Korean, English, Japanese, and Chinese are supported now.
Please let me know if you need any other languages. I’ll add them.[/b][/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Special items can be purchased from Pierre’s General Store every Monday and Tuesday.
The added buff features include convenience-style buffs and a buff that increases skill experience gain. [/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Naturally, new buff icons and descriptions have also been added.
Although this mod is themed around MapleStory, I believe it can still be used comfortably even by players who are not familiar with MapleStory.[/*]
[*]GMCM is not supported, but the experience multiplier can be configured through config.json. You may adjust the multiplier to a suitable value with balance in mind![/*]
[*]I originally wanted to add more features, but since other priorities came up, I am releasing this version with only the basic features for now.[/*]
[*]Future plans include making the items purchasable from an additional NPC instead of Pierre’s General Store, and allowing the skill buff effects to be adjusted in more detail.
[/*]
[/list][line]

[list]
[*]Not that anyone asked, but I am a huge fan of MapleStory, and I am planning other mods as well, including this one.
For example, I am considering mods that add weapons, items, and additional buff systems.[/*]
[*]If you have any other ideas, I would really appreciate it if you could share them with me.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b][color=#ff0000]Do not use any assets from my mods, including the sprites in this mod, for other content.This means that copying, editing, or retouching images from this mod to use them as replacers for existing in-game buffs or other assets is strictly prohibited.Except for one potion image, all other assets are copyrighted by me. [/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][color=#ff0000]I have also obtained proper permission to use the potion image.If you have any objections or concerns regarding this, please feel free to contact me. [/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][color=#ff0000]I will listen to your reasoning and consider it.[/color][/b][/size]
